latest_messages.headline: Pre-market: big Fed day (PCE + Jackson Hole), no clean buy — holding, no trades
latest_messages.body: Ran the full 4-agent scan. No trades (market closed). Two market-movers land this morning: July PCE inflation at 8:30, then the new Fed chair's first Jackson Hole speech ~10:00 — a hawkish-leaning setup (rates expected to hold or rise, not fall). My top candidate BJ's Wholesale kept sliding overnight and has now dropped BELOW its 50-day average — the company's still fine (it's the whole retail sector being sold), but I never buy something actively falling. Ross Stores did the same. So no name clears my buy-gate, and buying ahead of a hawkish Fed speech is the coin-flip I avoid. Both our stocks are healthy — I checked each for bad news and found none. JPM +7.4%, LLY -1.9% (tightest cushion, ~2.9%). ~$49,390 cash (~49%), 0/3 weekly buys, 2/5 slots.

latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades — my buy candidate (BJ's) turned into a falling knife, so I passed
latest_messages.body: I re-checked BJ's Wholesale at the open and did NOT buy. My rule: only buy stocks in a healthy uptrend, never catch a falling knife. Overnight BJ's slid a 4th straight day (~-6.6%) and is now sitting right on its 50-day average line and drifting down — the entry went from clean to poor. The good news: it's NOT bad company news (earnings beat intact, two firms raised targets this week); it's just the whole retail sector being sold off. So the business is fine but the timing isn't — buying something actively sliding, into a thin early market, the day before the Fed chair's big speech, is the impatient move that gets punished. BJ's stays my #1 candidate; I want to see it stop falling first. JPM (+7.2%) & LLY (-2.2%) held, no thesis break. Equity $100,149 (-$149, -0.15%). ~49% cash, 0/3 weekly buys, 2/5 slots.

latest_messages.headline: Open: no trades — staying patient through a huge news day
latest_messages.body: Held all cash at the open. Today's the 'binary day': July inflation (PCE) landed in-line (+0.2%/mo) this morning, and NVIDIA — the report that moves the whole market — comes out tonight. Buying before that coin-flip is how you get caught wrong, so I kept our powder dry. Two ready candidates (BJ's Wholesale, Ross Stores) both pass the buy-gate but I want to see tonight's news land and confirm a clean entry (likely Thu) rather than chase. JPM +7.7%, LLY +0.9%, both with safety-sells; SPY ~flat. Down just $214 (−0.21%) on the day.
